findings.message: INI directive 'safe_mode' is deprecated since PHP 5.3 and removed since PHP 5.4 (ini_get()/ini_set() of a directive that no longer exists returns false without an error, and this directive was already gone before PHP 8.3, so the upgrade changes nothing)

'enum' is a soft reserved keyword as of PHP version 8.1 and should not be used to name a class, interface, trait or enum or as part of a namespace (class declaration) (since PHP 8.1 enum is a keyword only when another name follows it, so a class named Enum (class Enum extends X) stays valid PHP)
